notes: Clean, fair design: each decoy fails exactly one constraint, so every review has to be read. The answer is unambiguous.
Liam's cheese-and-crema line is a fair red herring that he withdraws himself ('dairy-free tacos for the table'). It also sets up Roxy's dairy reveal naturally.
The 'mystery noodle stall' bit is a mild red herring, closed off clearly by Liam ('noodle hunt another night').
Budget is stated literally ('one-dollar-sign stalls only'), which makes it quite easy. The cards show price_tier, so it can be checked straight away.

Little Comet's review mentions a 'lactose-intolerant cousin' outright, so the dairy decoy is easy to spot. Blue Awning's review also names lactose directly. These keywords make the dairy check a little too obvious, but still fair.
